title: Chapter 2: Awakening of the Void
paragraphs: Stepping through the dimensional tear felt like diving into an ocean of liquid starlight.
The pressure exerted on Arthur's mortal meridians was immense, but the Void Prism expanded, absorbing the chaotic energy and tempering his body from within.
When he opened his eyes, he was standing on a floating obsidian platform surrounded by an endless expanse of purple nebulae.
In the center of the platform stood an ancient stone stele inscribed with divine characters that burned with celestial gold.
